'''Giovanni Zeno Giambelli''' (June 29, 1879 – December 31, 1953) was an Italian [[mathematician]] who is best known for [[Giambelli's formula]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Giovanni Giambelli {{!}} MATEpristem|url=https://matematica.unibocconi.it/autore/giovanni-giambelli|access-date=2020-09-16|website=matematica.unibocconi.it}}</ref>
